pages.text: Use the $(l:atum:divine/pharaoh_ritual)torch ritual$(/l) to target a god’s artifacts. The named loot pools and their contents are listed in this chapter. A named torch recipe combines a corresponding Godshard with four Nebu Torches.

Artifacts can be weapons, tools, armor, rings, or amulets. Equip rings in a Curios ring slot and amulets in a necklace slot. Wear armor in the usual four equipment slots and use hand-held artifacts as listed.

Save useful pieces and turn duplicates into matching shards with the $(l:atum:workshop/godforge)Godforge$(/l). The forge consumes each artifact. Some gear accepts Nebu Ingots for repairs. Inspect the individual item when combining or enchanting it.

To find a power, jump to $(l:atum:divine/anput)Anput$(/l), $(l:atum:divine/anubis)Anubis$(/l), $(l:atum:divine/atem)Atem$(/l), $(l:atum:divine/geb)Geb$(/l), $(l:atum:divine/horus)Horus$(/l), $(l:atum:divine/isis)Isis$(/l), $(l:atum:divine/montu)Montu$(/l), $(l:atum:divine/nepthys)Nepthys$(/l).
